# Vystorm Core

> Vystorm Core is a shared API for Paper/Purpur plugins: localized UI, commands, items, mobs, worlds, storage, web modules and cross-plugin services. These local documents cover Core 0.65.0, all 110 capability flags, and the Screens prototype; check capabilities and runtime service availability before using optional features.

## Start here

- [AI guide](docs/AI-GUIDE.md): Compact integration rules, complete capability catalog and checked Java examples.
- [Full API reference](docs/API.md): Public signatures, contracts, limits and integration examples.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Version history, including Screens changes in 0.57.0 through 0.59.0.

## API sections

- [1. Setup](docs/API.md#1-setup): Compile-only setup, dependency declaration and capability guards.
- [2. Build a plugin in 10 minutes](docs/API.md#2-build-a-plugin-in-10-minutes): Walkthrough for a first consumer plugin.
- [3. Ground rules: threads, lifecycle, errors](docs/API.md#3-ground-rules-threads-lifecycle-errors): Thread, owner lifecycle and failure rules.
- [4. Localization (api.lang())](docs/API.md#4-localization-apilang): Per-viewer language bundles, placeholders and translation audits.
- [5. Settings (api.settings())](docs/API.md#5-settings-apisettings): Personal/server settings, drafts and configuration editing.
- [6. Menus and managed inventories (api.gui())](docs/API.md#6-menus-and-managed-inventories-apigui): Main-menu registration and managed inventories.
- [7. Native dialogs (api.dialogs())](docs/API.md#7-native-dialogs-apidialogs): Dialog forms and input validation; see compatibility helpers for portable forms.
- [8. Chat actions and menu buttons](docs/API.md#8-chat-actions-and-menu-buttons): Expiring clickable chat actions and menu buttons.
- [9. Tutorials](docs/API.md#9-tutorials): Bundled guided tutorials.
- [10. Admin dashboard modules (api.admin())](docs/API.md#10-admin-dashboard-modules-apiadmin): Provider-owned admin dashboard modules.
- [11. Shared database](docs/API.md#11-shared-database): Asynchronous pool readiness and schema migrations.
- [12. Player data, XP, preferences, file storage](docs/API.md#12-player-data-xp-preferences-file-storage): XP, player values, serialization and file storage.
- [13. Debug messages](docs/API.md#13-debug-messages): Structured diagnostics and error reporting.
- [14. Web platform](docs/API.md#14-web-platform): Authenticated routes, public assets, live state and web localization.
- [15. Client mod: overlay and native HUD elements](docs/API.md#15-client-mod-overlay-and-native-hud-elements): Optional overlays, HUD elements and client negotiation.
- [16. Items, regions, curves, NBT and legacy handlers](docs/API.md#16-items-regions-curves-nbt-and-legacy-handlers): Items, regions, curves, packs and legacy public handlers.
- [17. Cross-plugin services](docs/API.md#17-cross-plugin-services): Runtime hubs, mobs, combat, parties, events and utilities.
- [18. Native panels (Vystorm.vystorm_core.panel)](docs/API.md#18-native-panels-vystormvystorm_corepanel): Typed UI trees, action handling and fallbacks.
- [19. Not public API](docs/API.md#19-not-public-api): Boundaries that consumer plugins must not depend on.
- [20. Rules for AI assistants](docs/API.md#20-rules-for-ai-assistants): Condensed rules and YAML pitfalls.
- [21. Versioning and compatibility](docs/API.md#21-versioning-and-compatibility): Binary compatibility and capability/version checks.
- [22. Appendix: Core commands and permissions](docs/API.md#22-appendix-core-commands-and-permissions): Built-in commands and permission declarations.
- [23. Managed worlds and visits (Vystorm.vystorm_core.worlds)](docs/API.md#23-managed-worlds-and-visits-vystormvystorm_coreworlds): Owned worlds, durable visits and recovery.
- [24. Commands (Vystorm.vystorm_core.commands)](docs/API.md#24-commands-vystormvystorm_corecommands): Localized command trees, typed arguments and help.

## Newer feature references

- [The managers (0.64.0)](docs/API.md#the-managers-0640): Every service through an accessor on API; table of accessors and the static classes they replace.
- [Event order between plugins (0.64.0)](docs/API.md#event-order-between-plugins-0640): Named stages instead of Bukkit priorities for events several plugins handle.
- [Placeholders (0.65.0)](docs/API.md#placeholders-0650): One registry for the values of all plugins, `%vystorm_<namespace>_<key>%` and `{namespace:key}`, PlaceholderAPI in both directions, Core's own values.
- [Compatibility helpers (since 0.48.0)](docs/API.md#compatibility-helpers-since-0480): Paper 1.20.6 feature detection and portable forms.
- [Core 0.51.0: shared Bukkit adapters](docs/API.md#core-0510-shared-bukkit-adapters): Shared Bukkit adapters and native persistence.
- [World-event runtime (0.31.0)](docs/API.md#world-event-runtime-0310): Durable owner-bound event execution.
- [Shared loot tables (0.34.0)](docs/API.md#shared-loot-tables-0340): Weighted tables, categories and mob loot.
- [Guided setup (0.52.0)](docs/API.md#guided-setup-0520): Selective cross-plugin settings presets.
- [Network (0.53.0, experimental)](docs/API.md#network-0530-experimental): Experimental proxy messaging and player transfers.
- [Inbox (0.55.0)](docs/API.md#inbox-0550): Personal localized messages, including offline delivery.
- [Profile cards (0.56.0)](docs/API.md#profile-cards-0560): Provider sections for online or offline players.
- [Screens (0.57.0, prototype)](docs/API.md#screens-0570-prototype): Pinned/floating modes, automatic UI adaptation, maps and GIFs.
